text: 你醒转过来，却发现那只可怕生物细长的手指正箍在你的喉咙上，扼断你的生机。它不断用力掐死你，同时猛烈摇晃你的身体。
你第二次失去意识时，最后看见的是那双可怕、毫无生气的眼睛，正凝视着你的灵魂。 你被来自另一个世界的存在杀死了。你不确定这只生物为何会出现在这里，但如今已无关紧要；你的尸体躺在这座湖畔小镇的街道上。你可以重新开始冒险再试一次，但眼下，你在埃斯伯里的旅程结束了。结局。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 243
text: You come to, only to find the hideous creature’s long-fingered hands wrapped around your throat, choking the life out of you. The creature shakes you violently as it steadily throttles you to death.

As you black out for the second time, the last thing you see are those horrible, lifeless eyes staring into your soul. You have been killed by a being from another world. Though you are uncertain how this creature came to be here, it matters little now, as your lifeless body adorns the streets of the lakeside town. Though you are free to start the adventure over and try again, for now, your visit to Esbury is over.
